blocks.text: Kaban Hotel and Casino Boracay has opened at Station 0, adding a new inland tourism and entertainment destination to the island’s world-famous beach attractions. The six-storey KABAN, which opened on Sept. 16, features an 88-room hotel, a 2,000-square-meter PAGCOR-licensed casino, seven dining concepts and a range of leisure facilities. It forms part of the 23-hectare master-planned development of Golden TW Realty and Development Corp. in Barangay Yapak.
